subject: You're invited: Medium Day 2026 — September 18

Medium

Medium Day

September 18
2026

Hi {{.FirstName}},

Every day, readers on Medium discover something new. Maybe a new idea, a new writer, or just a new way of seeing something familiar.

On September 18, we're celebrating that process of discovery at our fourth annual free, virtual, live Medium Day gathering.

Join us from 8 a.m.–5 p.m. ET on Friday, September 18.

Register now, free

This year's speaker lineup will let you take the opportunity to discover something new in a dozen different directions. Learn from scientists, founders, poets, and a few hundred years of combined Medium experience, all in one day.

  • See the schedule here, including confirmed speakers, tracks, and sessions.
  • Learn about our exclusive track available only to Friends of Medium.
  • And of course, don't forget to register here.

We can't wait to see you.
The Medium team
